The apical orifice is large, elongate, and beveled. The shell is pale green, finely sculptured with radial cords and grooves, with broad rays of brown. The inside is pale green, the callus not bordered. Resembling *F. virescens*, this form has finer sculpture and a distinctive color pattern.
